app.title: Show HN: Janus – Go binary that runs GGUF models via Vulkan on AMD/Intel/Nvidia
app.author: Maverick617
app.description: A Go-based binary that loads GGUF format language models and performs inference using Vulkan GPU acceleration on AMD, Intel, and Nvidia hardware.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the binary with `go build`.
Download a small GGUF model (e.g., `tinyllama.gguf`) and run a sample inference via the CLI: `./janus -m tinyllama.gguf -p "Hello, world!"`.
Measure the latency of a 1‑sentence prompt and compare it against the same model run with llama.cpp.
Run the binary in server mode (`./janus -s`) and issue a POST request to the `/infer` endpoint with a JSON payload; verify the response structure and latency.
Validate that the binary correctly falls back to CPU when no suitable GPU is found.
